en: Colorized panoramic view of a small European town seen from a grassy hillside with trees and a path in the foreground where two girls in dresses stand. The town below shows dense late‑19th/early‑20th century buildings with red and gray roofs, a prominent church with a tall spire, and a large institutional-looking building on the right. At the top center, red printed text reads "Hartha i. Sa." against a pale sky.
